INSERT INTO code_repository (id, name, root_path, language, status, source_type, remote_url, branch, commit_sha, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (CAST(#{id} AS uuid), #{name}, #{rootPath}, #{language}, #{status}, #{sourceType}, #{remoteUrl}, #{branch}, #{commitSha}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, root_path, language, status, source_type, remote_url, branch, commit_sha, created_at, updated_at FROM code_repository WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM code_repository WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
